radiometry_caveat.title: Ten Years of VIIRS Land Surface Temperature Product Validation
radiometry_caveat.claim: Article reports increased Desert Rock upwelling and downwelling IR since2018, especiallysummer, without similar airtemperature change; site/elevation representativeness also matters. This is a source-reported caveat, not a diagnosed cause in the new benchmark.
